SPEC:
East Asian fantasy RPG concept art for the world of Yuruma (year 1047 of the Shattered Sky era, five rival empires). Hero people: oni. Pink mana sky with pink clouds, turquoise jungles, equatorial highland plateaus, warm sunlight. Architecture: curved upturned East Asian roofs, red lacquered pillars, dark timber, rough stone plinths, black iron fittings, paper lanterns, cloth banners and noren curtains. Stylized realism, painterly, rich detail, lived-in, readable game-level composition, cinematic lighting. No text, no watermark, no logos of existing games.
Eye-level concept shot of the Street of Masters in Gharn, the capital of the Orc Horde (orcs, hobgoblins, goblins). This must read as a rich, crowded IMPERIAL CAPITAL craft street, not a village. Camera at 1.7 m in the middle of the street looking east along it toward the timber city wall at the far end.
Street: straight, 10-12 m wide, paved with dark rough cobbles with a worn cart track in the middle, stone gutters along both sides.
Both sides: an unbroken wall of attached two- and three-storey workshop-houses sharing side walls, no gaps: rough stone ground floors, dark timber upper floors with red lacquered pillars and red-railed balconies, curved upturned dark-tile roofs with bone and tusk ridge ornaments. Every ground floor is an open workshop or shopfront under a deep wooden awning with dyed noren curtains: a tannery with stretched hides, a potter with stacked jars, a brewer with kumis barrels, a carpenter with planks and a cart wheel, a weaponsmith with spear racks. Signboards with a single carved glyph hang on iron brackets from the facades.
Across the street at second-floor height: strings of red paper lanterns and clan pennants. Halfway down: a small square where a side lane crosses, with a stone well, a stone lantern pair, a carved wooden totem pole and a tall clan banner (tug). At the near end a red lacquered three-bay paifang gate with a dark tiled roof frames the street entrance.
Life: orc and goblin artisans at work, carts, crates, sacks and baskets against the walls (never blocking the street middle), drying laundry and hides on upper balconies, smoke from chimneys.
Late afternoon warm light, pink mana sky. Wide landscape composition, readable for level design: the street runs straight to the vanishing point.
